Name: Monster Fish
Author: RouxlzCat
Description:
Monster Fish adds [b]10 new fish[/b] with a monstrous and rare aesthetic, some inspired by other games, along with [b]10 exclusive items[/b] for fish ponds, including [b]2 new crops[/b], [b]3 valuable items, and 5 special food[/b].

Although there isn’t much content for now, depending on how well the mod is received I plan to keep updating it with more fish and maybe even add a couple of fishing-exclusive maps, so please endorse the mod.

Any suggestions regarding fish balance, items, or the mod in general are more than welcome.

[b]Locations, Times and Rarity[/b]
- [b]Bastard Dagon:[/b] 6:00am–6:00pm | Beach (Spring, Summer) | Common
- [b]Elden Fish:[/b] 12:00pm–2:00am | Beach (Fall, Winter) | Rare
- [b]Fish Punch:[/b] 6:00am–2:00am | Sewer (All Seasons) | Common
- [b]Pumpkin Fish:[/b] 6:00am–6:00pm | Mountain (Spring, Summer, Fall) | Uncommon
- [b]Infinite Food:[/b] 10:00am–6:00pm | Beach (All Seasons) | Common
- [b]Leaf Fish:[/b] 6:00am–6:00pm | Secret Woods (All Seasons) | Uncommon
- [b]Cursed Coral: [/b]12:00pm–2:00am | Beach (Fall, Winter) | Very Rare
- [b]Butcher Parasite:[/b] 12:00pm–6:00pm | Beach (Spring, Summer) | Uncommon
- [b]Rotten Minnow:[/b] 6:00am–6:00pm | Beach (Spring, Summer) & Sewer (All Seasons) | Common
- [b]Abyssal Angelus:[/b] 6:00am–2:00am | Beach (Fall, Winter) | Extremely Rare

[b]Fish Pond Drops[/b]
- Bastard Dagon: Rainbow Shell | Sea Jelly |[b] Deep Sea Pearl [/b]– Valuable item (4,500g)
- Elden Fish: Gold Ore | Iridium Ore | [b]Rune Arc[/b] – Increases Luck by +5 for the rest of the day
- Fish Punch: Bait (1–28) | [b]Suspicious Meat [/b]– Increases Max Energy by +35 for the rest of the day
- Pumpkin Fish: Pumpkin | Golden Pumpkin | [b]Peculiar Pumpkin Seeds[/b] – Can be planted in summer and fall
- Infinite Food: Deluxe Bait | Pink Cake |[b] Infinite Food Waste [/b]– Overpowered common food
Leaf Fish: Mixed Flower Seeds | Wild Bait |[b] Abyssal Root Seeds[/b] – Can be planted in - spring, summer, and fall
- Cursed Coral: Challenge Bait | Void Essence | [b]Weird Coral[/b] – Increases Attack by +5 and Fishing by +3, but reduces Defense by 5
- Butcher Parasite: Iron Ore | [b]Platinum Fang[/b] – More common than other valuable items (1,500g)
- Rotten Minnow: Green Algae | [b]Rotten Scale[/b] – Increases Speed by +2 but reduces Defense by 3
- Abyssal Angelus: Gold Bar | Golden Animal Cracker | [b]Golden Abyssal Heart[/b] – Valuable item (8,500g)

The mod includes translations for multiple languages, such as [b]Spanish, Portuguese, French, Korean, Russian, Simplified Chinese, and German[/b]. Some of these translations are automatically generated, so they may contain errors.

If you enjoyed the mod, please consider [b]donating[/b] on [url=https://ko-fi.com/rouxlz215246][b]Ko-fi[/b][/url]
Any support would be greatly appreciated 🗿💙
